title: Site and Landscape Ecology Field Studies
description:
Prerequisite: Must have completed or be concurrently enrolled in LARC230 or LARC640.
Corequisite: LARC265.
Restriction: Sophomore standing or higher; and must be in Landscape Architecture program.
Additional information: This course requires field trips. Field Excursions that are essential to apply theory and principles explored in the LARC265 to real world environments.
